content: NPM automation options: Sander0542/terraform-provider-nginxproxymanager (nginxproxymanager_proxy_host resource, importable) drives NPM's REST API; NPM has a token-authed REST API usable from CI/scripts. No native Kubernetes controller for NPM exists. NPM wildcard proxy host domains (*.example.com) are a long-standing feature request (issues #749, #591 - closed, mixed reports); wildcard SSL certs ARE supported and reusable across proxy hosts. Needs a build-time spike to confirm wildcard domain field acceptance in current NPM.
